caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair with four broad horizontal slats across the high backrest, two slender vertical posts that terminate in rounded knobs, and curved armrests attached to the upper half of the chair. The seat of the chair appears to be woven, likely from a natural fiber, and has a tan or light brown color. The legs and stretchers of the chair are simple and straight, with two sets of horizontal stretchers connecting the front and back legs, and a single stretcher joining the sides near the floor. The chair is rendered in shades of brown, with careful attention to wood grain and shadow, and the background is a plain, off-white color. At the bottom, handwritten text reads "Four Slat Bethrens Rocking Chair," along with a notation and the name "Alfred H. Smith."
title: Shaker Rocking Chair
